summary.text: Jay Morris is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 35, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Grant, Jackson, Lincoln, Ouachita, Rapides, and Winn parishes. First elected in 2019, Jay Morris chairs the Judiciary C Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Senate biography, Jay Morris served in the Louisiana House of Representatives from 2012 to 2019 before his election to the Senate in 2019.
The biography says that after graduating he clerked in Alexandria, then moved to Monroe, where he became a partner in the firm of Thompson, Sparks, Dean and Morris.

It describes him as the owner of Dean Morris, LLC, which focuses on mortgage servicing, banking, and real estate law, and of Morris Realty, Inc. and Louisiana Land & Farm, LLC, and says he lives in Monroe.
The Senate page, which lists the senator as John C. "Jay" Morris III, gives his education as a B.A. from Louisiana State University (1980) and a J.D. from the LSU Law School (1983).

The Senate page lists Jay Morris's committee assignments as Judiciary C (chair), Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs, Local and Municipal Affairs, Revenue and Fiscal Affairs, Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and State Bond Commission, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
